name: probierz
description: Cross-platform test automation toolkit: web, mobile (iOS/Android), desktop (Electron + native). Agent surface (CLI + stdio MCP) with a read-only discovery layer (surfaces/specs/run commands) and an execution layer that runs a target under chosen conditions, records video/trace/screenshots, and analyzes the result.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --workspace packages/web exec playwright install --with-deps && npm --workspace packages/electron exec playwright install
scripts.test:jeden: npm --workspace packages/web exec playwright test jeden
scripts.test:jeden:matrix: npm --workspace packages/web exec -- playwright test jeden.matrix --project=jeden-matrix --no-deps
scripts.test:jeden:scan: npm --workspace packages/web exec -- playwright test jeden.screen --project=jeden -g "command surface"
scripts.test:jeden:behaviour: npm --workspace packages/web exec -- playwright test jeden.replay --project=jeden
scripts.test:jeden:screen: npm --workspace packages/web exec -- playwright test jeden.screen --project=jeden -g "screen semantics"
scripts.test:jeden:journeys: npm --workspace packages/web exec -- playwright test jeden.screen --project=jeden -g "interaction journeys"
scripts.test:jeden:golden: PROBIERZ_UPDATE_GOLDEN=yes npm --workspace packages/web exec -- playwright test jeden.sidebyside --project=jeden
